roster.name: Compton Gamma Ray Observatory
roster.note: the gamma-ray member of the original four — it mapped the most violent events in the universe until it was deliberately de-orbited in 2000

roster.name: Nancy Grace Roman
roster.note: the next in the NASA lineage — a wide-field infrared survey telescope with a field of view a hundred times Hubble's, built to map the universe rather than stare at one patch of it
